name: Elqui Valley
shape: Chile Decreto 464, drawn from its comunas and provinces

notes: In its cool climate, Syrah becomes spicy and complex.

blurb.text: A northern Chilean valley in the Coquimbo region, at the southern end of the Atacama Desert, running from the Pacific to the Andes. It is known for table grapes and pisco.
